questions.q: In the upward phase of a bicep curl, which muscle is the antagonist?
questions.why: The triceps relaxes and lengthens while the biceps (agonist) contracts.

questions.q: A muscle lengthens while it contracts to lower a weight. This is
questions.why: Eccentric contractions control movement while the muscle lengthens.

questions.q: Which fibre type is best for a marathon runner?
questions.why: Slow oxidative fibres resist fatigue and work aerobically.

questions.q: Explain the role of the agonist and antagonist when the knee extends to kick a ball.
questions.model: The quadriceps is the agonist: it contracts (shortens) to straighten the knee. The hamstrings is the antagonist: it relaxes and lengthens to allow the movement.
